newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt cotton sales reach 15,500 T -exporters.
newsitem.headline: Egypt cotton sales reach 15,500 T -exporters.

text.p: Egyptian exporters said on Monday they sold 21,359 bales (6,974 tonnes) of cotton to international buyers last week, bringing the total sold in three weeks of the export season to 47,499 bales (15,508 tonnes).
The firms began selling their cotton on September 14 and Egypt expects to export between 125,000 and 150,000 tonnes of this year's harvest.

The Alexandria Cotton Exporters Association (Alcotexa), which coordinates prices and exports by 11 state owned firms and seven private ones, said three more countries bought cotton this week, bringing total purchasers up to 19 countries.
Italy and Switzerland have bought most of the cotton, followed by Japan, Germany and India.
Last week, Egypt ran out of Giza 45 cotton for export but all other eight varieties were still available.
Prices for seven varieties were unchanged for the third week running but exporters raised the price of the eighth variety, Giza 86, by one centilibre (U.S. cent per pound).
